scope: A Windows client: the headset PC may run Windows 10 or 11 (x64) as well as Bazzite. Every package carries version 1.0.0.7; the host driver is 1.0.0.6's.
changes: client/platform/windows/ (d3d11_video, vulkan_upload, process, dynamic_library, version resource, manifest), client/device/planar_upload.hpp, decoded_planes.hpp, cmake/windows-clang-cl.cmake: the native client for Windows, D3D11VA decoding on the adapter SteamVR uses (matched by LUID) with each picture copied through a staging buffer into the same fused frame pass; CPU decoding (H.264, HEVC) for troubleshooting

client/platform/linux/fused.comp, vulkan.cpp, client/device/conversion.hpp, CMakeLists.txt: fused-uniform.spv, the fused pass with its re-aim rows in a uniform buffer for drivers with 128 bytes of push constants (both platforms)
client/device/gaze.hpp, main.cpp, launcher/gaze_provider.py: gaze over loopback UDP (--gaze-udp, exclusive bind) where AF_UNIX datagrams are missing

launcher/: the client role on Windows: SteamVR found through openvrpaths.vrpath, stop through "quit" on standard input, firewall rules (Client-Firewall.ps1, the Bazzite client's ports), Wi-Fi media streaming mode and background scans off for sessions (windows_network.py), Best performance and keep-awake with a receipt (windows_power.py, session_power.py), crash details from the event log, tray with Start and Stop session and notifications, sign-in startup, Baballonia's Windows installer pinned and installed privately (or the user's own matching install used); Game Mode, Add to Steam and the display lease stay Bazzite's
launcher/session_link.py (shared with the host): network adapters through Windows' own interface, PowerShell only as the fallback

packaging/build_windows_client.py, windows-client-installer.nsi, build_windows_launcher.py (client role), windows-launcher.c: the per-user setup and the portable ZIP; scripts/Build-FFmpeg-Windows.sh, Build-Client-Transport-Windows.py, Build-Client-Windows.py: the cross-build

packaging/repack_host_payload.py: every licence file copied into the host package; packaging/collect_rust_notices.py: the Windows client's dependency graph; licenses/rust: 33 restored notice texts and the Windows-only crates' notices
scripts/package_public_source.py: the maintainer's private patterns from the environment, not the source

tests: the Windows modules' suites, tests/test_vrostbridge_1007.py, the page checks for the Windows view, the C++ tests planar_upload, software_decode, gaze_receiver and windows_process; tests/test_rc44.py no longer leaves threads spinning on a mocked event
Version 1.0.0.7 on every package; documents and release notes
review: Three documentation passes against the code found: the Windows client's firewall rules wider than the Bazzite client's (narrowed), a Steam-entry step in the Windows uninstaller (removed), the power mode of a crashed session not restored by the uninstaller (added), the Eye tracking card not saying when a Baballonia installed on the PC was found or used (added), a stale size in the uninstaller's question (corrected), and licence texts missing from the source tree and the Windows-only crates' notices (restored and collected).

host.driver: 1.0.0.6's build, byte for byte (ALVR f5023f8e with patches 0001 to 0020)

windows_client.native_rebuild_reproducible: rebuilt after a comment-only source change: all 23 files of the native folder byte-identical
